Package org.scilab.forge.jlatexmath

Class TeXIcon

java.lang.Object
org.scilab.forge.jlatexmath.TeXIcon
public class TeXIcon extends Object
The icon of a TeXFormula: its size, and the way to paint it on a TeXGraphics.

This class cannot be instantiated directly. It can be constructed from a TeXFormula using the TeXFormula.createTeXIcon(int,float) method.

    • paint

      public void paint(TeXGraphics g2, TeXColor defaultForeground, int x, int y)
      Paints the formula on a canvas that is not AWT (see PLAN.md, phase 2). The origin of the canvas is the top left corner of the icon; the foreground color is the one of setForeground(TeXColor), else the one given. If both are null, the color of the canvas is kept.
